channel.title: Worth the Fee
channel.description: Straight answers on whether a travel card or program is worth it for you.

item.title: Rakuten cash back rates today, by store (November 27)
item.description: The headline Rakuten cash back rate at 77 large stores, read from Rakuten's store pages on November 27, 2026, with what changed since the last reading.

item.title: Rakuten welcome bonus or a friend's referral bonus: which one do you get, and which is bigger?
item.description: On November 26, 2026 Rakuten's own pages showed a $10 welcome bonus and a member's link showed $50 after $50 of purchases. You get one, not both.

item.title: Rakuten Uber cash back: does it work, and what is excluded?
item.description: No cash back on Uber or Uber Eats as of November 26, 2026. Rakuten says the store is no longer available. Card-based Uber Cash still works.

item.title: Rakuten Ulta cash back: does Rakuten work at Ulta, and what is excluded?
item.description: Yes, Rakuten works at Ulta: 12% on November 26, 2026 (usual 2%). Dior, Marketplace items, gift cards and the part paid with Ulta rewards earn nothing.

item.title: Rakuten or Ibotta: how do they differ, and can you use both?
item.description: Rakuten is mainly an online shopping portal paid four times a year from $5. Ibotta is mainly grocery and receipt offers, withdrawn on request from $20.

item.title: Rakuten Marriott cash back: does it work, and what is excluded?
item.description: 3% on November 26, 2026, on the room rate only, capped at $100 per order. Points stays, member rates and hotels in Asia or Australia earn nothing.

item.title: Rakuten Hilton cash back: does it work, and what is excluded?
item.description: No Cash Back on November 26, 2026. Rakuten's Hilton page lists no rate and no terms. Buying Hilton points pays 1.25%; that is not a room booking.

item.title: Rakuten Home Depot cash back: does it work, and what is excluded?
item.description: No. On November 26, 2026, Rakuten's page for The Home Depot showed No Cash Back, as it did on November 21, 24 and 25. It lists coupons only.

item.title: Can you use Rakuten in store? Yes, with a linked card: how in-store cash back works
item.description: Can you use Rakuten in store? Yes. Link a Visa, Mastercard or Amex card, add the store's offer first, then pay with that card. No receipt upload.

item.title: Rakuten JCPenney cash back: does it work, and what is excluded?
item.description: No cash back on November 26, 2026. Rakuten lists JCPenney as "Coupons Only", with no rate and no terms. Kohl's showed 2% and Macy's 12% that day.

item.title: Rakuten Macy's cash back: does it work, and what is excluded?
item.description: Rakuten Macy's cash back is 12% on November 26, 2026 (usual 2%); furniture, electronics and marketplace items earn 1.5%. Gift cards earn nothing.

item.title: Rakuten DoorDash cash back: does it work, and what is excluded?
item.description: No cash back on DoorDash orders as of November 26, 2026. Rakuten's page reads "No Cash Back". Grubhub showed up to 4% and Instacart 1% that day.

item.title: Rakuten Apple cash back: is Apple on Rakuten, and what is excluded?
item.description: Yes, Apple is on Rakuten: 2% on November 26, 2026, only on accessories, refurbished items, AppleCare+ and Beats. New iPhones and Macs earn nothing.

item.title: Rakuten Best Buy cash back: does it work, and what is excluded?
item.description: Rakuten Best Buy cash back is up to 6% on November 26, 2026; most items earn 1%. Apple products, game consoles and gift cards earn nothing.

item.title: Rakuten Black Friday 2026: cash back rates read today, and how the deals work
item.description: Rakuten Black Friday cash back, read November 26, 2026: 12% at 600+ stores, such as Macy's (was 2%), and up to 20% at a few. Rates move daily.

item.title: How do you sign up for Rakuten, and what does it ask for?
item.description: Rakuten asks for an email and password, or a Facebook, Google or Apple sign-in. No card or bank account is needed to join; an address is needed to be paid.

item.title: Is Rakuten free? Yes, free to join and use, with one fee that can apply
item.description: Is Rakuten free? Yes: no fee to join or shop. A $5 monthly fee can apply after 12 idle months, and payment waits for a quarterly date and a $5 minimum.

item.title: Rakuten sign-up bonus: how the welcome and referral bonuses work, what to spend, and what makes one fail
item.description: Rakuten sign-up bonus, read November 26, 2026: one bonus per new member, earned after $25 or $50 of purchases within 90 days. Offers vary and change.

item.title: Sapphire Reserve Exclusive Tables: what the Chase program is and how to book it
item.description: Exclusive Tables holds prime-time tables and events for Sapphire Reserve cardholders on OpenTable. You add the card to an OpenTable account to book.

item.title: Rakuten or PayPal Honey: which one fits, and can you use both?
item.description: Rakuten pays cash or Amex points four times a year. Honey searches coupon codes and pays PayPal Rewards points. Only one is credited per order.

item.title: Rakuten Walgreens cash back: does it work, and what is excluded?
item.description: 2% on November 25, 2026, with no raised rate. Pharmacy, prescription drugs, gift cards and the part paid with Walgreens rewards earn nothing.

item.title: Rakuten Walmart cash back: does it work, and what is excluded?
item.description: Rakuten's Walmart page showed no cash back on November 25, 2026. A day earlier it showed a flat $5 on up to three orders. The offer comes and goes.

item.title: Rakuten Zappos cash back: does it work, and what is excluded?
item.description: 2% on November 25, 2026. Birkenstock, VRSNL, gift cards, orders paid with a gift card and Final Sale items over 50% off earn nothing.

item.title: TopCashback app: how does it work on iPhone and Android?
item.description: The free TopCashback app lets you shop stores, watch your earnings and cash out from a phone. It says cash back can take up to 6 weeks to show.

item.title: TopCashback browser extension: how does it work and what does it see?
item.description: The free TopCashback extension shows a pop-up on stores that pay cash back. It reads site addresses, not your searches, by its own privacy notice.

item.title: TopCashback Highest Cash Back Guarantee: how does the 110% match work?
item.description: If one of seven named sites shows a higher rate the day you buy, TopCashback says it pays 110% of that rate. You must claim within seven days.

item.title: How does TopCashback pay you, and when can you cash out?
item.description: You can cash out any time once cash back is marked available: to a bank, Venmo, PayPal or a gift card. Each store sets how long that takes.

item.title: Rakuten Skechers cash back: does it work, and what is excluded?
item.description: 3% on November 25, 2026, with no raised rate. Orders over $500, five or more of one item, gift cards and loyalty rewards earn nothing.

item.title: Rakuten Sonos cash back: does it work, and what is excluded?
item.description: 2% on November 25, 2026, with no raised rate. Gift cards and dealer orders earn nothing, and a code not listed on Rakuten voids cash back.

item.title: Rakuten Staples cash back: does it work, and what is excluded?
item.description: Up to 6% on November 25, 2026, raised from 2%. Ink, toner and tech earn 2%. Computers, tablets, HP printers and gift cards earn nothing.
